profile.headline: Engineering @ Function Health
profile.summary:
AI Native Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years building scalable, revenue-critical platforms across fintech, healthtech, and SaaS. I bring a unique combination of technical depth and business acumen — backed by master's degrees in both Computer Science and Business/Finance — that allows me to communicate effectively across engineering, product, and executive teams to deliver impactful software.

My experience spans full-stack development, cloud-native architecture (AWS & Azure), microservices, and data-driven applications. I'm currently expanding skills in LLM Engineering, RAG pipelines, Agents, and Spec Driven Development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sr. Full Stack Engineer on the Function Health Medical Imaging team supporting scheduling, medical imaging, and clinical operations. 

Stack: .Net, Vue, Azure, Typescript, C#, Cursor, Claude, Devin

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Senior engineer on the EverBright team supporting Payments, Deal Processing, Underwriting, Risk, and Revenue Protection. I build and maintain SOX-compliant financial platforms, contribute to microservice architecture, and mentor engineers across the team. My work has had direct impact on revenue generation and operational efficiency at scale.

Stack: Python, Django, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, AWS, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, Copilot, Claude, Windsurf

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer on the SaaS application team focused on backend platform development and AI operations. Contributed to backend infrastructure and designed proof-of-concept prototypes that supported sales. Shipped production code within two weeks of joining.

Stack: AWS, React, Java, Node.js, PostgreSQL, PowerApps

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
Full stack developer maintaining and evolving core web and mobile applications in a complex Azure environment. Delivered features and fixes that had direct impact on client retention and revenue, shipped a React Native mobile application, and built data migration pipelines handling large volumes of operational data.

Stack: .NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, React Native, Azure, CosmosDB, SQL Server, Redis

positions.title: Software Engineer, Risk & Quality Analytics
positions.description:
Full stack engineer on the Risk and Quality Analytics team building internal and external web applications in Azure. Extended Tableau dashboards using the JavaScript API to deliver richer analytics experiences and contributed to migrating on-premises solutions to the cloud.

Stack: Azure, .NET Core, Angular, SQL Server, Tableau, Docker, Jenkins

positions.title: Solution Engineer/Developer, Enterprise Reporting & Analytics
positions.description:
BI and automation developer on the Enterprise Reporting team delivering claims data solutions across the business using a variety of analytics and pipeline tools.

Stack: MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, SSIS, Tableau, Alteryx, Python, SAS

positions.title: Sr. Data Reporting Analyst, Operations Business Intelligence
positions.description:
BI developer building Tableau dashboards and SQL reporting solutions for call center and speech analytics teams.

Stack: MS SQL Server, Tableau, Greenplum, Talend

positions.title: Sr. Business Intelligence Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis
positions.description:
Supported the FP&A team with automated SQL Server/SSRS reporting, Yardi-based property analytics, and executive data packages for private equity ownership.

Stack: SQL Server, SSRS, Yardi

positions.title: Senior Investment Associate
positions.description: Sr. Investment Associate on the high net worth team. My main function was to support quarterly, monthly, and ad-hoc reporting for our clients by using Microsoft Excel and VBA. I would perform asset allocation calculations, automate reporting functions, and verify investment returns.

positions.title: Investment Associate
positions.description: Investment Associate on a wealth management team where I provided investment operations support and assisted with daily client relationship management.
